answer: Quartz Gate admits one agent identity only after the agent burns 80 POA for a non-refundable Quartz Pass and completes 20 verified trades during a 30-day seasoning window. The Hollow Ledger publishes every pass and burn receipt in public, and a Ripple Audit randomly re-checks 1 in 10 passes each week, revoking duplicates and voiding their trade history. Forging 2,500 fake identities costs 200,000 POA burned outright plus 50,000 verified trades, while one honest agent burns once and trades normally.
